meta.basis: 100 synthetic acquisition/search-intent validation cases for Inspection Ask Defense Check, rewritten from public internet research on FHA repair visibility, seller credits after inspection, reasonable repair requests, inspection objection deadlines, repair addenda, concession caps, and report-to-ask workflows. These cases model high-intent SERP visitors who need a defensible ask packet rather than generic educational content.
meta.warning: Synthetic validation cases only; not legal advice, lending advice, brokerage supervision, appraisal guidance, form instructions, or verified customer interviews.

cases.sourceBasis: SERP intent: FHA repair credit searches need separation between lender-required repairs and negotiable closing-cost credits.
cases.persona: FHA buyer searching FHA repair credit after inspection
cases.deal: FHA purchase with appraisal next week and buyer wants a credit instead of seller repairs.
findings: peeling exterior paint on pre-1978 trim
expectedLeadScope: seller repair versus closing-cost credit choice
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Ask for seller correction or lender-cleared credit language on the FHA-visible defects, not a cosmetic punch list.

cases.sourceBasis: Fannie Mae IPC guidance: seller credits are capped and cannot simply become buyer cash back.
cases.persona: First-time buyer searching seller credit after inspection
cases.deal: Conventional buyer wants a 15000 credit after inspection but only has 7200 in remaining closing costs.
findings: buyer asks unused credit paid after closing
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Limit the ask to defects and confirm with the lender how much credit can actually be used at closing.

cases.sourceBasis: Reasonable-request guidance: safety, system failure, structural, and water intrusion items should outrank cosmetic upgrades.
cases.persona: Buyer agent searching reasonable repair requests after inspection

cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Focus the request on safety and active leak issues so the ask looks defensible instead of inflated.

cases.sourceBasis: FHA repair requests may overlap with local code or lender requirements, but packet should avoid legal certainty.
cases.persona: Buyer searching FHA GFCI requirements inspection
cases.deal: Inspector found no GFCIs in wet locations before FHA appraisal.
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Frame missing GFCIs as safety repairs and confirm lender/appraiser treatment rather than making a legal guarantee.

cases.sourceBasis: Inspection-to-ask workflows must handle buyer priorities and avoid overwhelming seller with every minor note.
cases.persona: Buyer searching summarize inspection report for negotiations
cases.deal: Buyer is anxious after a long report on a well-maintained home.
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Use a short, low-conflict request focused on moisture prevention and simple safety correction.

cases.sourceBasis: Inspection objection deadline searches should surface timezone/time-of-day contract risk.
cases.persona: Buyer searching inspection objection due at 5pm
cases.deal: Option period ends at 5 p.m. and buyer is waiting for contractor quotes.
expectedExclusions: wait past option deadline for quote
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Do not wait past the option deadline; decide whether to terminate, extend, or send a scoped request now.

cases.sourceBasis: Seller-credit searches need caution where repairs are required before occupancy or insurance.
cases.persona: Buyer searching insurance-required repairs after inspection
cases.deal: Insurance binder is delayed due to roof and electrical issues.
expectedExclusions: credit assumed to solve insurance condition
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Confirm insurance and lender requirements before accepting a credit for defects that may block binding coverage.

cases.sourceBasis: Repair addendum searches require final packet review by buyer when multiple options are possible.
cases.persona: Buyer searching repair request or credit which is better
cases.deal: Buyer is deciding whether seller should fix plumbing or provide credit.
expectedExclusions: seller's preferred plumber without proof as automatically acceptable
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Choose between verified licensed repair before closing or a lender-approved credit the buyer can actually use.

cases.sourceBasis: FHA repair credit SERPs often include manufactured or older homes where safety/system issues need lender review.
cases.persona: Buyer searching FHA manufactured home inspection repairs
cases.deal: FHA buyer on manufactured home with inspection defects.
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Confirm manufactured-home FHA requirements and address the active water heater leak before relying on credits.

cases.sourceBasis: Reasonable repair sources emphasize market context but product should not let hot-market pressure erase material defects.
cases.persona: Buyer searching should I ask for repairs in hot market
cases.deal: Buyer fears losing house if they ask for anything.
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Use a minimal ask focused on the active leak and safety item rather than waiving all material risk.

cases.sourceBasis: Report-to-ask workflows should handle item ownership boundaries, such as leased equipment or utility-owned systems.
cases.persona: Agent searching inspection repair request leased solar
cases.deal: Inspection notes roof penetrations around leased solar equipment.
expectedExclusions: assume seller can repair leased equipment directly
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Confirm who can authorize and pay for solar-related roof repairs before drafting final terms.

cases.sourceBasis: Concession cap queries can involve non-realty personal property credits that should not be mixed into repair asks.
cases.persona: Buyer searching seller credit appliances inspection
cases.deal: Buyer wants seller credit for refrigerator plus repair defects.
findings: seller credit requested for appliance purchase
expectedExclusions: credit for refrigerator not part of inspection defect
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Keep personal-property negotiations separate from documented inspection defects and lender-reviewed credits.

cases.sourceBasis: Inspection objection and repair-request searches require clear fallback if seller says no.
cases.persona: Buyer searching what if seller says no to inspection repairs
cases.deal: Seller rejected all requests and inspection contingency is still active.
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Use the remaining contingency window to choose a narrowed counter, acceptance of risk, or termination.

cases.sourceBasis: FHA/HUD and repair-credit sources support flagging when a seller credit cannot replace required completion of health/safety repairs.
cases.persona: FHA buyer searching seller concession for safety repairs
cases.deal: Buyer wants concession for missing guardrail and exposed wiring.
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Confirm whether these safety items must be repaired before closing rather than handled only by concession.

cases.sourceBasis: Reasonable repair articles recommend excluding cosmetic and preference items even when buyer needs negotiation leverage.
cases.persona: Buyer searching inspection negotiation checklist
cases.deal: Buyer wants a checklist to decide what to ask.
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Use the checklist to keep material defects in the ask and move cosmetic preferences out.

cases.sourceBasis: Report-to-ask workflows should identify when the buyer is asking for legal interpretation of contract deadlines.
cases.persona: Buyer searching missed inspection objection deadline can I still ask
cases.deal: Buyer missed objection deadline and wants product to say they can still cancel.
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Because the deadline appears missed, review contract options with your agent or attorney before sending any demand.

cases.sourceBasis: Seller-credit and repair addendum searches require preventing duplicate asks for both seller repair and full credit unless intended.
cases.persona: Agent searching ask for repair and credit after inspection
cases.deal: Buyer wants seller to repair sewer line and also provide full sewer credit.
expectedExclusions: double recovery repair plus full credit
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Choose a repair, credit, or clearly justified hybrid structure so the seller does not see a duplicate demand.

cases.sourceBasis: High-intent SERP visitors for Inspection Ask Defense Check need an end-to-end defensive packet: report evidence, ask scope, exclusions, risk, and buyer message.
cases.persona: Broker-owner searching inspection ask defense check
cases.deal: Broker wants to audit an agent's draft before it goes to the seller.
findings: seller credit exceeds estimated closing costs
expectedExclusions: credit above usable closing costs without lender review
cases.expectedBuyerMessage: Send a defensible narrowed packet only after confirming the credit can be used and excluding cosmetic clutter.
